Influence matters: max influence gets extra 5% bank (≈3.25M plus license holder is me — license income extra). President role holder is idx1; bribing doesn't change presidency since law holder determined at law phase by influence — bribing now could make me president in round 6 law. President can veto. Card unknown; remaining cards? Used: 4,8,0,1,3. Remaining: 2,5,6,7. Tax 20%, +infl richest, price shift — price shifts irrelevant (no more market), so bad cards: 2 (tax 20% future sales — no future sales, harmless), 5 (+1 influence to richest — richest is me, +1 influence helps get 5% bonus, good!). So pass seems fine. Bribe to gain influence for the 5% commission: cost 5M vs gain ~3.25M+weight? Not worth. Pass.
